recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO later wants the optional DeviceUsage-to-DeviceDefinition relationship added to the graphic, handle it as a separate diagram-source/editorial review rather than as a required FHIR-50440 core source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-50440 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for the R6 Device module diagram. It asked that DeviceUsage point to Patient via .patient and suggested considering whether DeviceUsage should also point to DeviceDefinition via .device in addition to Device.
initial_application: The Jira record says the change was applied in FHIR-50445. Related PR HL7/fhir#3836 and commit ff73a37610861abf2a0351a2a882ceab35a88237 replaced the old diagram image reference with DeviceModule.svg, added the image asset, and changed the Device module prose to describe the diagram as showing some key representative relationships rather than every valid reference.
additional_context: publish.ini lists DeviceModule.svg in the active image list and device-module.html in active page lists. source/device-module.html embeds DeviceModule.svg and tells readers to review the respective resources for all valid relationships. DeviceUsage and DeviceDispense now link from the core module page to the OO incubator. FHIR-50445 and FHIR-50446 already have issue-reconcile commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The build-scoped current page and rendered SVG already convey the requested DeviceUsage/Patient relationship in the representative diagram context approved by the related application, and the only possible further tweak would be diagram-only work that should not be forced into a source-changing core reconciliation commit.
